name: loudkit
description: Offline text to speech on your own computer: add local speech to an app, pick a voice, make WAV files from text, clone a voice you have the right to use.

interface.longDescription: loudkit is an open-source speech engine with open weights. It runs on your own computer, with no account and no cloud API. This plugin adds local speech to a Python, JavaScript, Rust, Go or Swift project and helps you pick one of 28 voices in 10 languages. In a coding agent on your own computer, it also makes WAV files from text and clones a voice from a short recording you have the right to use. In ChatGPT, it gives you the code and commands to run locally. Your text and recordings are never sent to us: we run no servers. The model is downloaded once from Hugging Face.
defaultPrompt: Add offline text to speech to this project.
Make a WAV file of this paragraph on my computer.
